_note: CMS-style data. A block that needs a value stays hidden until the value is filled in here. Never put placeholder text in these fields.

where_work_is_done_options.A: Your manager is based in the UK. Some processing work is done by our qualified team in India, under UK supervision, inside your own accounting software. That is part of how we keep fees fixed. Your data stays in UK and EU-hosted systems, and everyone who touches it works under the same confidentiality and data protection rules.
where_work_is_done_options.B: All client work is done by our team in the UK.

software_logos._note: Logos switched on at the owner's request (24 Nov 2026). Xero's brand rules limit its logo, and Hubdoc's, to Xero partners: join the Xero partner programme before launch. Set a value to null to show the name as text instead.

_approved_posts_note: Add a post's slug here once the named accounting reviewer has signed it off. It then loses its draft note, becomes indexable and joins the sitemap.
_vat_threshold_note: VAT registration threshold used by the free VAT checker. £90,000 from 1 April 2024. The accounting reviewer must confirm it is current before launch and each April.
